mapper.select: SELECT id, storage_uri, mime_type, checksum_sha256, duration_ms FROM digital_asset WHERE checksum_sha256 = #{checksum} AND asset_kind = 'AUDIO' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO digital_asset ( asset_kind, storage_uri, mime_type, checksum_sha256, duration_ms ) VALUES ( 'AUDIO', #{storageUri}, #{mimeType}, #{checksumSha256}, #{durationMs} )

INSERT INTO utterance ( session_id, input_channel, intent_type, transcript, audio_asset_id, asr_confidence, vad_duration_ms ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{inputChannel}, #{intentType}, #{transcript}, #{audioAssetId}, #{asrConfidence}, #{vadDurationMs} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, input_channel, intent_type, transcript, audio_asset_id, asr_confidence, vad_duration_ms FROM utterance WHERE id = #{utteranceId}

SELECT pw.id AS song_id, pw.title, s.artist_name, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(sa.alias_text ORDER BY sa.id SEPARATOR ',') FROM song_alias sa WHERE sa.song_id = pw.id ) AS aliases, ( SELECT da.storage_uri FROM song_resource sr JOIN digital_asset da ON da.id = sr.asset_id WHERE sr.song_id = pw.id AND sr.resource_role = 'COVER' ORDER BY sr.display_order, sr.asset_id LIMIT 1 ) AS cover_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pw.updated_at DESC, pw.id DESC) AS display_order FROM playable_work pw JOIN song s ON s.work_id = pw.id WHERE pw.work_kind = 'SONG' AND pw.playable_status = 'READY' ORDER BY pw.updated_at DESC, pw.id DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN category LIKE '%历史%' THEN 'INSTRUMENT_HISTORY' WHEN category LIKE '%曲%' THEN 'SONG' ELSE 'INSTRUMENT_STRUCTURE' END AS source_type, id AS source_id, id AS knowledge_item_id, title, content FROM knowledge_item WHERE enabled = TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'INSTRUMENT_STRUCTURE' AS source_type, id AS source_id, NULL AS knowledge_item_id, name AS title, CONCAT_WS('；', summary, function_text, position_text, performance_relation) AS content FROM instrument_part WHERE enabled = TRUE AND part_kind = 'COMPONENT'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'INSTRUMENT_HISTORY' AS source_type, id AS source_id, NULL AS knowledge_item_id, title, CONCAT_WS('；', time_label, content) AS content FROM history_entry WHERE enabled = TRUE
UNION ALL
SELECT 'SONG' AS source_type, pw.id AS source_id, NULL AS knowledge_item_id, pw.title, CONCAT_WS('；', s.artist_name, s.origin_period, s.background_text, s.style_text) AS content FROM playable_work pw JOIN song s ON s.work_id = pw.id WHERE pw.work_kind = 'SONG'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_answer (utterance_id, answer_text, model_name) VALUES (#{utteranceId}, #{answerText}, #{modelName})

INSERT INTO answer_source ( answer_id, knowledge_item_id, rank_no, relevance_score ) VALUES
( #{source.answerId}, #{source.knowledgeItemId}, #{source.rankNo}, #{source.relevanceScore} )
